mapping.notes: M20 Planar Cleansing's verified DESTROY over an ALL selector, filter TYPE_EQ Creature. The probe destroys every creature, nothing else.

clauses.evidence: [cast] events 'you_bear / you_giant / opp_flier / opp_tapped / opp_bear / opp_giant moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/DESTROY)' and 'dies' for each: every creature of both sides, tapped or not; no change to the relics, charms or lands. Pack D04_1 (passes): an artifact creature is destroyed, an indestructible creature survives (a destroy, not an exile or damage), a plain artifact and an enchantment stay, life unchanged. Pack D04_2 (passes): it is a sorcery, refused on the opponent's turn ('window:not_your_turn').
